rows.surface: Private prepare/review/commit authority before simple container provisioning
rows.mechanism: Name and existing device proxy selection lead to prepareContainer, not provisioning. The daemon performs a selected-proxy region lookup with no direct fallback, generates a complete validated candidate and retains at most eight immutable private drafts for five minutes. An opaque token, exact revision, app/container scope, source directory/Info.plist/executable identity, full secure proxy configuration and cloud account/origin bind each review. Public receipts contain only safe summaries; identifiers and credentials remain private. Explicit Create consumes the token before clone effects and uses daemon-held metadata/profile, ignoring client replacements. Discard/review cannot create; expired/restarted/stale authority is rejected. Interrupted or partially failed Create requires its durable receipt and inventory reconciliation; no automatic retry. Legacy no-token creation retains its existing path. Device proxy selection remains distinct from cloud per-container assignment and does not permit Open or bypass MDM.
